description:
You are the Chief Pilot at Stratos Air Charter. The FAA has issued new guidance on 'Clean Aircraft Concept' verification, requiring an immediate update to the General Operations Manual (GOM). 

1. Open the existing manual chapter at '/home/ga/Documents/GOM_Ch7_ColdWeather.odt'.
2. Read the revision instructions in '/home/ga/Documents/revision_order.json'.
3. Replace the text in Section 7.4.1 (Pre-Takeoff Check) with the new text provided in the JSON file.
4. Apply a visual 'Revision Bar' (vertical line) to the left side of the updated paragraph in Section 7.4.1. Use 'Format > Paragraph > Borders' to apply a left border (width >= 1.00 pt).
5. Locate the 'WARNING' paragraph immediately following Section 7.4.1. Format this paragraph to have a Box Border (all 4 sides) and Bold text.
6. Update the document header: Change 'Revision: 04' to 'Revision: 05' and update the date to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD).
7. Save the updated manual as '/home/ga/Documents/GOM_Ch7_Rev05.odt'.
